conclusion: No text configuration significantly outperforms another on the locked 104-clip test; every paired-bootstrap 95% CI crosses zero. E2 (expanded 5-fold ensemble, 0.7017) is the best point estimate and nominally meets the 0.70 gate, but is statistically indistinguishable from the 0.6866 champion (p=0.36) and from E1 (p=0.13). E1's fold-mean 0.6239 reproduces the earlier 5-fold CV mean 0.626, confirming honest text skill ~0.62-0.65. Text-only performance is capped by data size / annotation noise at this test size; the intended remaining gain is multimodal fusion (Phase 3).
integrity_notes: Folds are built from the train split only; best epoch chosen on fold-validation; test scored once. No test tuning.
